title: Mediterranean Roast Chicken
description: A flavorful Mediterranean-inspired roast chicken recipe with warm and springy notes. Perfect for a delicious and satisfying dinner.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as Brussels sprouts or carrots

instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, toss the roasted vegetables with some olive oil, salt, and pepper.
After the chicken has cooked for 20 minutes, add the roasted vegetables to the oven and continue cooking for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the chicken rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the chicken with the roasted vegetables and drizzle with lemon juice.
